page_title: Nepal Tour Packages - 7 Days Kathmandu, Pokhara | AlpenGlow
title: Kathmandu, Pokhara & the Himalayan Foothills
overview_paragraphs: Nepal compresses the Himalaya's scale into a trip that doesn't require technical trekking experience — Kathmandu's temple-dense old town, Pokhara's lakeside calm with the Annapurna range as backdrop, and an early-morning mountain flight that gets you eye-level with Everest without the multi-week trek.
Suited to travelers who want genuine Himalayan scenery and culture on a comfortable, non-trekking itinerary.

places.name: Kathmandu
places.tagline: Temple squares, stupas, and the Living Goddess, all in one valley
places.modal_tagline: WHERE THE TRIP BEGINS AND ENDS
places.desc: Kathmandu opens with a traditional khada welcome and closes with a full day of sightseeing: Pashupatinath Temple, one of Hinduism’s most revered sites, Boudhanath Stupa, one of the largest stupas in the world, and Kathmandu Durbar Square, a UNESCO World Heritage Site home to the Kumari House, where Nepal’s Living Goddess resides.

places.name: Pokhara
places.tagline: A lakeside city framed by the Annapurna range
places.modal_tagline: NEPAL’S CITY OF LAKES AND MOUNTAINS
places.desc: Pokhara’s day starts before dawn with a sunrise visit to Sarangkot Hill for Himalayan views, followed by Bindabasini Temple, Davis Falls, Gupteshwor Cave, and boating on Fewa Lake, Nepal’s largest, out to the mid-lake Talbarahi Temple. The town is also Nepal’s adventure hub, with options for ultra-light flights, zip-lining, and bungee jumping.

places.name: Lumbini
places.desc: Lumbini centers on Maya Devi Temple, marking the Buddha’s birthplace, alongside Kapilvastu, Kudan, and Ramagrama Stupa, a quiet, spiritually significant stop between Pokhara and Chitwan.

places.name: Chitwan
places.tagline: A national park built for elephants, crocodiles, and jungle walks
places.desc: Chitwan National Park fills a full day with jungle activity: the elephant breeding center, a canoe ride on the Budhi Rapti River to spot crocodiles, an elephant safari, jungle walks, and bird watching, closing with an evening Tharu cultural show.

places.name: Manakamana
places.tagline: A hilltop temple said to grant wishes
places.modal_tagline: A PILGRIM STOP ON THE ROAD BACK TO KATHMANDU
places.desc: On the drive back from Chitwan, Manakamana Temple is dedicated to the goddess believed to fulfill the wishes of those who visit, a popular pilgrimage stop between the jungle and the capital.

meta_description: A 7-day Nepal tour package covering Kathmandu’s temple quarter, lakeside Pokhara under the Annapurna range and an early-morning Himalayan mountain flight.
